name: Payment radar and instance actions
description: Verify payment risk views and instance action controls work.

planSteps.description: The Ödemeler workspace shows tabs for Özet, Takvim, Ödeme kalemleri, Eksik veriler, and Geçmiş
The overview renders missing-data, overdue, today, tomorrow, next-seven-days, monthly-summary, and risky-days sections when applicable
If a missing-amount open payment exists, enter 1 in its amount field and click KAYDET; otherwise verify no missing amount action is offered
The action completes without server error and the edited row no longer shows an empty amount field
On an open payment click ÖDENDİ, wait for completion, then click GERİ AL on the same payment
The payment switches to paid and then back to open without duplication or page error
Open the Takvim tab and select a day containing payments
The selected day detail lists its payments and retains understandable risk and status labels
